GitHub - holger-kibur/sdf: Signed distance field and raymarching based ...
Attempting to make a game-ready signed distance field (SDF) and raymarching (RM) based graphics engine, built on top of a traditional rasterization pipeline. SDF+RM has the potential to trivialize many of the hardships of creating convincing visuals in rasterization based graphics (shadows, reflections, global illumination, raytracing ...
